body: Symptom: app crashes immediately on a real machine (silent, no useful error). Cause: libsql (via @libsql/client) is a NATIVE module; node_modules binary is built for system Node, Electron ships a different NODE_MODULE_VERSION → createClient() in initDb() crashes the main process. node-level smokes pass (wrong runtime), masking it. Fix: @electron/rebuild devDep + 'electron-rebuild -f -m . -w libsql'; wired as predev script AND Taskfile dev deps:[rebuild] so it auto-runs. Verified headless: '[main] initDb…' → '[main] db ready' under Electron. Also hardened: initDb try/catch→dialog.showErrorBox, process uncaughtException/unhandledRejection handlers, renderer window.onerror overlay (no more blank-screen crashes). RULE: any native dep (libsql, better-sqlite3, etc.) in an Electron app MUST be electron-rebuilt; never trust a node-only smoke for Electron native modules.
title: apps/desktop crashes on launch: libsql native module not rebuilt for Electron ABI
